description: This source file contains the implementation of the PathHelper class within the PdfSharp.Quality namespace. The class provides a static method to generate a file system path based on the current directory and specified folder/sub-paths.

classes.name: PathHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing path manipulation functionalities, specifically to construct paths based on a given folder name and sub-path.

methods.name: FindPath
methods.description: Builds and returns a path by locating a specified folder in the current directory path and replacing the path segment after that folder with a provided sub-path.
